license_required.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to engage or to continue in this state in the business of contracting, or to act as a contractor as defined in this Chapter, unless he holds an active license as a contractor in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: There is hereby created the State Licensing Board for Contractors within the office of the governor.

name.quote: There is hereby created the State Licensing Board for Contractors within the office of the governor.

type.quote: There is hereby created the State Licensing Board for Contractors within the office of the governor.

umbrella_agency.quote: There is hereby created the State Licensing Board for Contractors within the office of the governor.

required.quote: An applicant for a license or registration shall submit a financial statement on a form supplied by the board, current to within twelve months of the date of filing the application, prepared and signed by an accountant, bookkeeper, or certified public accountant and signed by the applicant

experience_source.quote: An applicant for a license or registration shall submit a financial statement on a form supplied by the board, current to within twelve months of the date of filing the application

exams.name: Trade examination (classification-specific)
exams.notes: An applicant shall designate a qualifying party who must satisfy examination and credential requirements for each classification; the board may exempt holders of comparable out-of-state licenses from the trade portion.
exams.quote: The qualifying party shall meet all application requirements and shall satisfy any examination and credential requirement.

exams.name: Louisiana Business and Law examination
exams.notes: The business law requirement is not waiveable even for holders of comparable out-of-state licenses.
exams.quote: The business law requirement shall not be waived.

interval_years.quote: Licensees shall elect upon renewal one-, two-, or three-year license renewal terms, and licenses may be issued by the board on a multiple-year basis, not to exceed a three-year renewal term for any license.

required.quote: To prescribe and adopt regulations and policies for continuing education.

available.quote: Waive the trade portion of the examination requirement for any applicant holding a license in a comparable classification in another state as determined by the board, upon written certification from the licensing state that the applicant passed the examination for the classification and is in good standing.

requirements.value: The board may waive the trade examination for an applicant holding a comparable out-of-state license upon written certification from the licensing state that the applicant passed the exam and is in good standing. The business law examination is not waiveable, and the applicant must comply with all other Louisiana licensing requirements.
requirements.quote: Waive the trade portion of the examination requirement for any applicant holding a license in a comparable classification in another state as determined by the board, upon written certification from the licensing state that the applicant passed the examination for the classification and is in good standing. The business law requirement shall not be waived. Applicants shall comply with all other licensing requirements of this state

exists.quote: There is hereby established within the board the Residential Contractors Subcommittee

name.quote: There is hereby established within the board the Residential Contractors Subcommittee, hereinafter referred to as 'residential subcommittee'

authority.value: Subject to the approval of the board, the residential subcommittee has powers to adopt rules and regulations, issue/suspend/revoke licenses for residential and home improvement contractors, prescribe continuing education requirements, and enforce provisions of this Chapter.
authority.quote: Subject to the approval of the board, the residential subcommittee has all of the following powers and duties: (1) To adopt rules and regulations to govern residential and home improvement contractors in this state. (2) To issue, suspend, or revoke licenses to do business in this state

regulatory_model.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to engage or to continue in this state in the business of contracting, or to act as a contractor as defined in this Chapter, unless he holds an active license as a contractor in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter.

credential_type.quote: Grant licenses to qualified persons pursuant to this Chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to engage or to continue in this state in the business of contracting, or to act as a contractor as defined in this Chapter, unless he holds an active license as a contractor in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter.

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any contractor, licensed or unlicensed to publish, transmit, distribute, or otherwise publicly circulate a misleading or false claim related to a person's license or classification in any medium

scope_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person to engage or to continue in this state in the business of contracting, or to act as a contractor as defined in this Chapter, unless he holds an active license as a contractor in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Undertaking, attempting, or bidding on construction work without possessing a required license or without the proper classification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Undertaking, attempting to, or submitting a price or bid; offering to construct, supervise, superintend, oversee, direct, or in any manner assume charge of the construction, alteration, repair, improvement, movement, demolition, putting up, tearing down; furnishing labor or furnishing labor together with material or equipment; or installing material or equipment for any building, highway, road, railroad, sewer grading, excavation, pipeline, public utility structure, project development, housing, or housing development, improvement, or any other construction undertaking without possessing a license for which a license is required or without possessing a license with the proper classification.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing or distributing a misleading or false claim related to a person's license status or classification.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing, transmitting, distributing, or otherwise publicly circulating a misleading or false claim related to a person's license status or classification in any medium, including but not limited to digital platforms.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any dishonest or fraudulent act as a contractor that has caused damage to another, as adjudged by a court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any dishonest or fraudulent act as a contractor which has caused damage to another, as adjudged by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation of fact by an applicant in obtaining a license or providing information to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation of fact by an applicant in obtaining a license; misrepresentation of fact by an applicant or licensee in providing information, statements, or documents to the staff or board; deception by omission; and providing false testimony to the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the provisions of this Chapter or the rules and regulations promulgated thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of this Chapter or the rules and regulations promulgated pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into a contract with an unlicensed contractor for work requiring a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into a contract with an unlicensed contractor involving work or activity for the performance of which a license is required by this Chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting or fraudulently using a license for any purpose by any person other than the person to whom the license was issued.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting a license to be used for any purpose by any person other than the person to whom the license is issued.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a qualifying party to represent the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain a qualifying party to represent the licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to continue to fulfill any of the requirements for licensure.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to continue to fulfill any of the requirements for licensure.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disqualification or debarment by any public entity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disqualification or debarment by any public entity.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide written notification to the board of changes to application information or pending criminal/civil/administrative actions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide written notification to the board of any change to the information provided in the original application and any amendments thereto within thirty calendar days.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide written name, license number, classification, and insurance information to the contracting party.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a contractor performing residential construction, home improvement, or mold remediation in accordance with this Chapter to provide, in writing to the party with whom he has contracted to perform services, his name, license number, classification, and current insurance certificates

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandoning or failing to perform, without justification, any contract or project, or deviating from plans or specifications without consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandoning or failing to perform, without justification, any contract or project engaged in or undertaken by any licensee or deviating from or disregarding plans or specifications in any material respect without the consent of the owner and the design professional.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Efforts to deceive or defraud the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain a required permit or beginning work before permit issuance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to obtain a permit to perform work or beginning work prior to the issuance of a permit in the jurisdiction as required or misrepresenting the value or scope of work.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to obtain inspections as required by law.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to obtain inspections as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to have a written contract signed and dated by all parties.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to have a written contract signed and dated by all parties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to bid, contract, or perform work in the name as it appears on the current license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to bid, contract, or perform work in the name as it appears on the current license or registration and the official records of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain and provide requested records, documents, and information to the board within five business days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain and provide to the board requested records, documents, and other information as required within five business days of receipt of request.

bonding_required.quote: Any person required to be licensed by the board that bids a project requiring a bid bond, the posting of a bid bond for the project, or certificates of insurance evidencing mandated coverage and fails to provide such valid bonds or coverage when due shall be subject to all provisions for violations and penalties thereof.

insurance_required.quote: Residential construction and its subclassifications, mold remediation, and home improvement applicants shall be required to submit certificates evidencing workers' compensation coverage in compliance with Title 23 of the Louisiana Revised Statutes of 1950, and liability insurance in a minimum amount of one hundred thousand dollars

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A local building department shall not issue a building permit to any person who does not hold an active license in the appropriate classification for the scope of work for which the permit is issued.

definition_quote.value: "Contractor" means any person who undertakes to, attempts to, or submits a price or bid or offers to construct, supervise, superintend, oversee, direct, perform, or in any manner assume charge of the construction, alteration, repair, improvement, movement, demolition, putting up, tearing down, furnishing labor, or furnishing labor together with material or equipment, or installing material or equipment
definition_quote.quote: "Contractor" means any person who undertakes to, attempts to, or submits a price or bid or offers to construct, supervise, superintend, oversee, direct, perform, or in any manner assume charge of the construction, alteration, repair, improvement, movement, demolition, putting up, tearing down, furnishing labor, or furnishing labor together with material or equipment, or installing material or equipment

methods_authorized.quote: The major classifications are: (1) Building construction. (2) Highway, street, and bridge construction. (3) Heavy construction. (4) Municipal and public works construction. (5) Electrical. (6) Mechanical. (7) Plumbing. (8) Hazardous materials. (9) Residential construction. (10) Mold remediation. (11) Home improvement.

insurance_personal_injury_minimum_usd.quote: liability insurance in a minimum amount of one hundred thousand dollars

self_insurance_permitted.quote: liability insurance in a minimum amount of one hundred thousand dollars or liability protection provided by a liability trust fund as authorized by R.S. 22:46(9)(d) in a minimum amount of one hundred thousand dollars

contract_must_be_written.quote: Every agreement to perform contracting services that requires licensure or registration as defined by this Chapter shall include all of the following documents and information

minimum_project_value_usd.quote: Any improvements or repairs to an existing residential structure for which the project value is seven thousand five hundred dollars or more.

fraud_felony_threshold_usd.quote: any person who does not possess a license from the board and violates any of the provisions of this Section, and causes harm or damage to another in excess of three hundred dollars, upon conviction, shall be fined not less than five hundred dollars nor more than five thousand dollars, or imprisoned, with or without hard labor, for not less than six months nor more than five years, or both.

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: The provisions of this Chapter shall preempt any municipal or other local regulatory examination authority over all licensees.

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: except for licenses required by parishes and municipalities for the purpose of determining the competency of mechanical or plumbing contractors, or both, and electrical contractors, no contractor shall be liable for any fee or license as a condition of engaging in the contracting business.

registration_renewal_interval_years.quote: Licensees shall elect upon renewal one-, two-, or three-year license renewal terms, and licenses may be issued by the board on a multiple-year basis, not to exceed a three-year renewal term for any license.

out_of_state_disciplinary_action_reporti.quote: Any criminal, civil, or administrative actions instituted or pending in any jurisdiction against or involving the licensee or any principal of the licensee.
